earn.title: Freelance marketplaces
earn.subtitle: Fiverr, Upwork and similar
earn.text: Start with data entry, transcription and logo design. Small first jobs build reviews, and reviews bring bigger clients.

earn.title: Sell digital products
earn.subtitle: Templates and packs
earn.text: Package logo templates, flyer packs or Excel templates once, then sell them many times.

earn.title: Virtual assistant work
earn.subtitle: Remote admin
earn.text: Businesses pay for email handling, scheduling, spreadsheets and research done remotely.

earn.title: Teach what you know
earn.subtitle: Online tutoring
earn.text: Teach PC basics, Excel or CorelDRAW to beginners over WhatsApp or video call.

earn.title: Create content
earn.subtitle: YouTube, TikTok, blog
earn.text: Turn the tutorials on this page into videos. Income comes later, once you build an audience.

earn.title: Affiliate marketing
earn.subtitle: Recommend tools you use
earn.text: Earn a commission when people buy software or services through your honest recommendation.
